defects.justification: Runs are scheduled at anchor + k*interval as fixed Instants, where the anchor is the local firstRunAt converted once at startup; after a daylight-saving change a 24h schedule configured for local 02:00 runs at 01:00 or 03:00 until the process restarts, so it no longer follows the configured local time.

S3Store (single vs multipart upload, part sizing, abort on failure, paginated listing) has no tests at all; the tests only use an in-memory FakeStore, so the real upload/abort logic is never exercised.

The status HttpServer uses the default single-threaded executor with no read or idle timeout, so one client that opens a connection and never finishes its request blocks the status endpoint for everyone.
